# Click event payload shape and defaults

> [`LinkClicked`](link-click-analytics.md) is a typed, versioned `link.clicked` event that describes one click on a share link, with three required strings and three optional details that fall back to empty or false.

_Part of [The link.clicked event and its payload](link-clicked-event.md)_

[`LinkClicked`](link-click-analytics.md) is defined at the top of `share-link.service.ts` with `defineEvent('link.clicked', 'links', 1, ...)`. That helper gives the event a name, a topic (`links`) and a version number (1). The payload shape is a `zod` object, so the data is checked against it. Three fields are required strings: a unique click id, the link code and a timestamp. Three more are optional: country, referer and a flag for whether the edge already saw the click. If they are missing, `zod` fills in an empty string, an empty string and `false`. The event is built in `recordClick`. It makes a fresh click id with `uuidv7()`, stamps the time as an ISO string, cuts the referer to 300 characters, and turns missing country or edge values into the defaults. It then sends the event to Kafka without waiting. See [Recording a click without slowing the redirect](fire-and-forget-click-recording.md) for that part, and [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md) for what consumes the event.

**Look at:** [`LinkClicked` in share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts#L17) · [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts)

## Pieces

- Required fields: click id, link code and timestamp: Three strings that must always be present: `clickId` (the unique id of this click), `code` (the short link code) and `ts` (when the click happened, as an ISO string).
- Optional click details with default values: `country` and `referer` default to an empty string, and `viaEdge` (whether the edge already recorded the click) defaults to `false`, so a payload without them is still valid.
- Event name, topic and version from defineEvent: `defineEvent('link.clicked', 'links', 1, schema)` ties the name, the `links` topic and version 1 to the payload shape, and `LinkClicked.create` and `LinkClicked.topic` use them.
- [Building the event in recordClick](fire-and-forget-click-recording.md): `recordClick` fills the payload: a `uuidv7()` click id, the current time, the country and edge flag with fallbacks, and a referer cut to 300 characters.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| event | `link.clicked` | Built by `recordClick` with `LinkClicked.create` and sent as the message value, one per redirect click. |
| queue | `links (LinkClicked.topic)` | The Kafka topic the event is sent to, keyed by the link code. |

## Watch out

- The defaults only apply when a field is missing. `recordClick` already supplies `''` and `false` itself, so the `zod` defaults matter mostly to other code that parses the event.
- The referer is cut to 300 characters in `recordClick`, not in the schema, so the schema itself does not limit its length.
- The click id is a `uuidv7()`, made on every call, so one click is one id. Deduplication downstream relies on that id.
- The event is keyed by the link code, so all clicks for one code go to the same partition.
